title: nogat-handoff/1
description: Data handed from one tool's GUI to another's (item 6 of docs/plans/2026-11-01-nogat-gui-platform.md): an envelope with provenance and the providers' attribution around one domain document, the payload. Projects copy this file like schemas/agent/ (ECO-050) and never define the envelope themselves. The envelope does not check the payload's content: a consumer validates it against its owner's schema and refuses kinds it does not take. Unknown fields are allowed: adding optional fields keeps the version (AGI-4.1).

created_at.description: When the producer wrote the hand-off: RFC 3339 date and time with an offset, UTC (`Z`) by preference

subject.description: What is handed off, as the person named it (a watershed, a network); shown by the consumer

provenance.description: Where the inputs of the payload came from, one entry per input (`rainfall`, `watershed`, ...); empty when nothing is known. The values the payload holds are not repeated here, only what produced them (e.g. the PMAXTP probability and duration of a design depth). True for the whole payload; `node_provenance` refines it per node

node_provenance.description: Where the inputs of each node of the payload came from, keyed by the `id` of the node (a payload with nodes, such as `hydrolog-network/1`); each value is keyed like `provenance`, by input (`watershed`, `runoff`, `rainfall` of a subcatchment, `node` for the node's own fields and place). An entry here takes precedence over `provenance` for its node and input; a node or input without one takes `provenance`. A key that names no node of the payload is left out by the consumer with a notice (docs/plans/2026-11-10-node-provenance-in-handoff.md)

attribution.description: The attribution lines the providers' terms require for the data in the payload and result, verbatim and in the order of DEV-20.4 of Nogat's standard (IMGW-PIB, hydro.imgw.pl, PMAXTP, ČHMÚ): required whenever the hand-off carries provider data or results derived from them. The consumer shows every line visibly with the loaded data and carries them on, without duplicates, into its own products and any further hand-off (DEV-20.6). Optional within `/1` (AGI-4.1)

terms_notice.description: The notice of the IMGW-PIB terms of use and the addresses of the terms that apply, verbatim and in the order of DEV-20.7 of Nogat's standard: required whenever the hand-off carries IMGW-PIB data or results derived from them. The consumer shows and carries it on like `attribution`. Optional within `/1` (AGI-4.1)

tool.description: Lowercase project name of the registry (`hydrolog`, `hydrograf`)

producer.description: The tool that wrote the hand-off

version.description: The producer's package or app version

page.description: Where the person returns to in the producer: a fragment of its page (`#hydrogram`) or an address

origin.description: The origin of one input: `source` names it (a tool, a data set such as `pmaxtp`, or `user` for values a person typed); the other fields are its parameters (`probability_percent`, `duration_min`, `latitude`, `longitude`, ...)

node_inputs.description: The origins of the inputs of one node, one entry per input

payload.description: The domain document handed off, `<tool>-<kind>/<n>` (AGI-4.1), validated by the consumer against its owner's schema. Known payloads: `hydrolog-network/1` (Hydrolog, `src/hydrolog/schemas/hydrolog-network-1.schema.json`): one watershed is one `subcatchment` with the values used and the `outlet`, joined sub-catchments are more nodes

result.description: The producer's own result of the payload, for comparison only: a consumer recomputes and shows it beside its own numbers, never as an input. For `hydrolog-network/1` the values of the outlet

command.description: What computed it: a catalog command (`hydrograph generate`) or an endpoint of an app

computed_with.description: The tool and version that computed the result when it is not the producer (Hydrograf computes with Hydrolog)
